features.name: network_activity_score
features.description: Composite score representing the breadth of network and internet access requested by the application.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a dense severity measure of network capability, helping the linear SVM establish a margin based on overall network access rather than individual sparse flags.

features.name: high_risk_telephony_score
features.description: Sum of telephony and SMS permissions, which are frequently abused for premium SMS fraud or data exfiltration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates high-risk telephony features into a single continuous-like dimension, allowing the SVM to apply a unified weight to telephony abuse potential.

features.name: location_tracking_intensity
features.description: Measures the intensity of location tracking capabilities requested by the app.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a smooth gradient of location tracking severity, improving the linear model's ability to penalize excessive tracking.

features.name: storage_and_media_access
features.description: Evaluates the extent to which the app can access local files, camera, and microphone.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces dimensionality by grouping related media and storage permissions, providing a more robust signal for the SVM decision boundary.

features.name: system_persistence_and_stealth
features.description: Calculates a score based on permissions that allow an app to run at startup, stay awake, draw over other apps, and monitor tasks.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights persistence mechanisms commonly used by background services, offering a strong linear projection for behavioral risk.

features.name: personal_data_exposure
features.description: Sum of permissions related to reading or modifying user contacts, accounts, and calendar events.
features.expected_model_benefit: Consolidates personal data access into a single severity metric, which is highly effective for linear models assessing privacy risks.

features.name: launcher_manipulation_count
features.description: Counts permissions related to installing/uninstalling shortcuts and modifying launcher badges.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures aggressive UI manipulation tactics often seen in adware, providing a clear numerical feature for the SVM to weight.

features.name: telephony_to_network_ratio
features.description: Ratio of telephony/SMS permissions to basic network permissions, smoothed to avoid division by zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies apps that request heavy telephony access without corresponding network needs, creating a non-linear interaction feature that is linearly separable for the SVM.

features.name: suspicious_behavior_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of highly sensitive permissions such as sending SMS, reading phone state, drawing over apps, and requesting package installations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a pre-calculated, weighted severity score that directly aligns with the margin-maximization objective of a linear SVM.

features.name: hardware_control_index
features.description: Measures the extent of hardware control requested, including bluetooth, camera, vibrate, and flashlight.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups miscellaneous hardware controls into a denser feature, reducing sparsity and improving model generalization.

features.name: suspicious_permission_synergy
features.description: Semantic assessment of whether the app requests a combination of permissions that are rarely needed together in benign apps (e.g., SMS + Internet + Boot Completed), indicating potential botnet or spyware behavior.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures complex, multi-permission interactions that a linear model cannot easily learn from raw binary flags alone.

features.name: adware_monetization_potential
features.description: Semantic assessment of the app's likelihood to aggressively monetize via ads or unwanted shortcuts, based on the presence of billing, launcher shortcuts, and system alert windows.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous risk score for adware-like behavior, allowing the SVM to separate aggressive monetization tactics from standard app functionality.
